extraction_notes: Transfer, output, body-diode, and capacitance curves were digitized from the typical characteristics on p. 3; plotted values are typical curve reads, not guaranteed limits.
The transfer-curve figure does not state its VDS bias, so the extraction preserves that omission rather than assigning a VDS value.
The tabulated capacitances are typical values at VDS = 15 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz: Ciss = 1614 pF, Coss = 245 pF, Crss = 215 pF.

The datasheet also publishes typical gate charge Qg = 33.7 nC, Qgs = 8.5 nC, and Qgd = 7.5 nC at VGS = 10 V, VDS = 15 V, ID = 30 A; these are retained as extraction context but have no field in the strict schema.
The body-diode table gives VSD maximum 1.2 V at VGS = 0 V, IS = 30 A.
The PDF has no stated document revision; PDF metadata creation date is 2020-03-13 and modification date is 2024-08-30.
